title: PAMIR locally cached NASA educational reference
notice: Curated educational summaries, not live telemetry or engineering predictions. Game resource rates are fictional. No NASA endorsement is implied.

records.title: MARS · ENVIRONMENT
records.text: Mars preserves evidence of a wetter ancient environment. Its thin atmosphere does not provide a breathable environment for astronauts.

records.title: MOON · SURFACE SCIENCE
records.text: Lunar geology records Solar System history. Scientific instruments can investigate moonquakes and the Moon’s interior.

records.title: WHY ANALYZE SAMPLES?
records.text: Perseverance investigates Martian geology and ancient habitability and collects rock and regolith samples. Laboratory analysis helps scientists interpret minerals and past environments.

records.title: MOXIE · USING LOCAL RESOURCES
records.text: MOXIE demonstrated oxygen production from the Martian atmosphere. The base oxygen generators in this game illustrate in-situ resource utilization; their rates and costs are simplified gameplay values.

records.title: ORBITAL MAINTENANCE
records.text: Spacewalks allow astronauts to maintain and upgrade station equipment. EVA requires life support and safety systems. The game’s 12-metre tether, oxygen gauge and automatic recovery are simplified mechanics, not operational procedures.
